value.answer: Depends on your down payment. Under 20% down (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed is about 4.34% right now, with Frank Mortgage offering it. With 20% or more down (uninsured), the lowest is about 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%. Rates have been creeping up this month, so grab the low ones soon if you're looking.
